summary.what_it_does: The page is a directory-style ledger of AI tools aimed at game developers, with entries for tools such as Ziva, Retro Diffusion, PixelLab and Anthropic Claude. Each entry records dated changes to pricing, usage allowances, and terms. Examples on the page include Retro Diffusion's free trial balance and per-image prices, PixelLab's tileset generation costs and terms updates, and Ziva's Hobby plan and Playtest Agent platform details. The page also covers ownership of outputs for commercial games, license caveats, and Steam disclosure. The page text shown is mostly a dated changelog, so it does not give a full description of the site's scope beyond these entries.
